Usage: agentcage scaffold create [OPTIONS] NAME

  Create a new user scaffold.

  Examples:
    agentcage scaffold create my-agent
    agentcage scaffold create my-claude --from claude-code

Options:
  --from TEXT  Fork an existing scaffold as starting point.
  --force      Overwrite existing scaffold.
  --no-color   Disable colored output.
  --quiet      Suppress progress output (spinners and banners).
  -h, --help   Show this message and exit.
